# Contributing
## Git Strategy
We are using [Gitflow](https://www.atlassian.com/git/tutorials/comparing-workflows/gitflow-workflow) branching strategy, meaning all branches are based on `develop`, and production is sourced from `main`. When creating a new branch, please use the `name/feat/fix-your-feature-or-fix-name` format, for example `bryan/feat-docs` or `bryan/fix-tests`.
